title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2025/2026
text:
AB101
Elementary Modern Standard Arabic I
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
Taught in Arabic.
This
course
will introduce
students
to Arabic as a language and a culture. The emphasis will be put initially on speaking and listening with authentic audio, video material. This course is designed for students with no previous knowledge in Arabic.
Additional Course Information
Exclusions
Any formal or informal knowledge of Arabic.
